description: Rooftop photovoltaic (PV) potential data for the Swiss building stock is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alina Walch (Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne, Switzerland). The provided dataset contains data for the PV potentials on building rooftops, evaluated for 9.6 M roof surfaces in Switzerland in an hourly temporal resolution. The methodology of the generation of the dataset is described in: Walch, Alina, Roberto Castello, Nahid Mohajeri, and Jean-Louis Scartezzini. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
